Sections.title: General Map and Report Review
Sections.subtitle: Florida baseline; apply data-related items to the work performed.

items.title: Purpose and Scope
items.statement: Identify the product type and intended purpose.

items.title: Horizontal Control and Accuracy
items.statement: State the horizontal datum and control; retain independent accuracy checks and methods.

items.title: Vertical Control and Accuracy
items.statement: For elevation data, state datum and control and document accuracy and verification methods.

items.title: Assumed Datum Control
items.statement: If using an assumed datum, distinguish it from published datums and provide reproducible control.

items.title: Dated Supporting Records
items.statement: Retain dated measurements and computations supporting the product.

items.title: Responsible Surveyor and Business
items.statement: Show responsible surveyor name/license and issuing business name, authorization number, and street/mailing addresses.

items.title: Acquisition and Revision Dates
items.statement: Identify the last acquisition date and subsequent graphic revision dates.

items.title: Signature and Seal Statement
items.statement: Include the required original-signature/seal validity statement unless electronically signed and sealed.

items.title: Map Orientation and Legend
items.statement: Show north, scale, defined survey abbreviations, and the bearing reference to an established monumented line.

items.title: Mapped Feature Responsibility
items.statement: Identify responsibility for mapped features and integration of others' work.

items.title: Final Delivery Review
items.statement: Confirm signed/sealed deliverables, sheet references, filenames, revision consistency, and contracted formats before release.

items.title: Definitive Boundary Calls
items.statement: Write metes-and-bounds calls that unambiguously identify each boundary line.

items.title: Sketch Matches Description
items.statement: Depict every referenced description element and identify the sketch as not a survey.

items.title: Initial Point Tie
items.statement: Tie the initial description point to a government corner, recorded corner, or established survey point.

items.title: Commencement and Beginning
items.statement: Distinguish commencement from beginning; verify ties, directions, distances, and referenced monuments.

items.title: Independent Closure and Area
items.statement: Independently compute perimeter closure and area; reconcile rounding, curve geometry, exceptions, and stated units.

items.title: Record References and Location
items.statement: Check source instruments, recording references, section/township/range or subdivision identifiers, county, and state.

items.title: Curve and Line Agreement
items.statement: Compare every line and curve call to the sketch, including radial/nonradial relationships and tables.

items.title: Intended Estate or Purpose
items.statement: Confirm the described parcel, easement, or other intended interest matches the client's instructions; resolve ambiguous scope before release.

items.title: Source and Fieldwork Limitations
items.statement: Identify record sources and whether fieldwork was performed; avoid implying a sketch is a boundary survey.

items.title: Sheet Pairing
items.statement: Ensure description and sketch sheets share job identifiers, revision dates, and complete cross-references.

items.title: Recipient Format
items.statement: Verify recipient-required exhibit labels, certification wording, file format, and recording/submittal instructions.
